title: F3 agent output (PREREG section 6.1; read by audit/f3_compare.py)
description: The F3 agent writes one file <world_seed>.json per test world and one verdict_table.json into its output folder. Every fraction is a string "p/q" in lowest terms with q >= 1 (an integer n is written "n/1", zero "0/1"); an undefined metric is null. No floats anywhere. Configuration keys are written exactly as in the input's "configs" (alpha as printed there, a vertical bar, k), for example "0.95|0" and "0.7|5".

metrics.description: Every metric of SPEC section 8 at every one of the 30 grid points: {"<alpha>|<k>": {metric: fraction or null}}.

feasible.description: Configuration keys of the feasible points under tau (fidelity >= tau_s, deviation <= tau_d, consistency >= tau_t, uncertainty <= tau_b; all four defined, and new_true defined), in any order.

pareto_front.description: Configuration keys of the non-dominated feasible points (x = 1 - new_false, y = new_true), ordered x descending, then y descending, then alpha ascending, then k ascending.

hypervolume.description: Area of the union of the rectangles [0, x] x [0, y] over the feasible points, exactly.

t1_structure.description: The T-1 structure of the world (PREREG section 3.2, I-5), defined as audit/descriptive.t1_structure does: feasible points are those of the feasible set; the two flags are booleans; each of the three pair fields is true (every considered pair holds), false (some considered pair violates the bound 1/20) or null (no considered pair has distinct uncertainty).

verdict_table_file.description: verdict_table.json: one row per test (G1..G6 from the given per-world outcomes, G7 = G7a, G8, T-1), by the rules of PREREG sections 3.3 and 4. The Wilson lower bound is a string with three decimals for G8 and T-1 (as printed in the verdict text) and null for the deterministic tests.

first_failing_world.description: The world_seed of the FAILS world with the smallest draw_index, or null if no world FAILS.
